opening.argument: The course presents a BitConnect referral and account-funding pathway requiring at least $100, directing viewers to follow an external link and fund the account with Bitcoin. It then promotes BitConnect lending as a way to earn daily profits, claiming returns of up to 0.25% daily and promising a first interest payment the very next day. The instruction to reinvest that immediate interest and compound profits frames the activity as an opportunity to act quickly and profit. The records do not establish that anyone transferred funds, received returns, or experienced a loss, and they do not independently verify the external service.
